Claude 宣布 Claude Security 不再只做一次性扫描：连接仓库一次后，Claude 先跑一次深度基线扫描，之后按变更的风险和复杂度在代码合入时复扫，让漏洞结论跟上代码现状；修复合入后发现项会自动标记为已修复，问题重新出现则自动重开。条件：目前在 Claude Enterprise 上公测，需要管理员在后台开启；据官方文章，符合条件的组织在 2026 年 12 月 31 日前可获得为期两个月、每月最高 2.5 万美元的额度。Claude announced that Claude Security no longer performs only one-time scans. After a repository is connected once, Claude runs a deep baseline scan, then rescans when code is merged according to the risk and complexity of changes, keeping vulnerability findings aligned with the current code. After a fix is merged, findings are automatically marked as resolved; if an issue reappears, it is automatically reopened. Condition: currently in public beta on Claude Enterprise and must be enabled by an administrator in the console. According to the official article, eligible organizations can receive an allowance of up to $25,000 per month for two months through December 31, 2026.

OpenAI 宣布 ChatGPT 广告新增 26 个国家，总数达到 89 国，其中拉美新增 14 国（阿根廷、智利、哥伦比亚、秘鲁等），另有尼日利亚、南非、塞尔维亚、乌克兰、柬埔寨、孟加拉、巴基斯坦等。广告上线 8 个多月来，已有超过 10 万家广告主投放；ChatGPT 每周用户超过 12 亿。广告主可通过技术合作伙伴或自助的 Ads Manager 投放。同日 OpenAI 开发者博客公开了广告系统的架构：LLM 编排器、检索、排序和竞价如何协同，同时保证回答独立。限制：广告只出现在免费版和 Go 版，Plus、Pro、企业版不出广告；官方称不向广告主透露对话、不出售用户数据。据路透，OpenAI 广告业务 8 月年化收入已达 10 亿美元。OpenAI announced that ChatGPT ads have expanded to 26 additional countries, bringing the total to 89. Latin America accounts for 14 of the new countries, including Argentina, Chile, Colombia, and Peru; others include Nigeria, South Africa, Serbia, Ukraine, Cambodia, Bangladesh, and Pakistan. More than 100,000 advertisers have run campaigns in the over 8 months since ads launched; ChatGPT has more than 1.2 billion weekly users. Advertisers can place campaigns through technology partners or the self-serve Ads Manager. On the same day, OpenAI’s developer blog published the architecture of the ad system, explaining how the LLM orchestrator, retrieval, ranking, and bidding work together while keeping answers independent. Limitation: ads appear only on Free and Go plans; Plus, Pro, and Enterprise plans have no ads. OpenAI says it does not reveal conversations to advertisers or sell user data. OpenAI 用数千个 GPT-Rosalind 智能体并行分析数百万个小鼠脑细胞：32 分钟完成，发现胆固醇运输与神经退行性病的新线索OpenAI uses thousands of GPT-Rosalind agents to analyze millions of mouse brain cells in parallel: 32 minutes to uncover new clues about cholesterol transport and neurodegeneration

OpenAI 与 PerturbAI、斯克利普斯研究所合作，让数千个基于生命科学模型 GPT-Rosalind 的智能体并行分析全脑 CRISPR 图谱：每个智能体负责一个基因扰动，分析细胞反应、检索文献、提出机制解释，32 分钟跑完；团队估计人工逐个分析要几个月到一年。在最大工作量下，分布式智能体引用了 700 多篇文献，单个智能体只引用 11 篇；盲评中专家 75% 的情况更偏好分布式报告。具体发现包括：Tsc1 和 Tsc2 在小脑的影响差异很大，与结节性硬化症相关；扰动帕金森样疾病相关基因 DCTN1 会提高胆固醇合成基因的表达，提示「胆固醇没送到神经元需要的地方」。这些都是待实验验证的假设，不是已证实的结论；推理图谱已公开。OpenAI partnered with PerturbAI and the Scripps Research Institute to have thousands of agents based on the life-science model GPT-Rosalind analyze a whole-brain CRISPR atlas in parallel. Each agent handled one gene perturbation, analyzing cellular responses, retrieving literature, and proposing mechanistic explanations; the run finished in 32 minutes. The team estimates that analyzing each case manually would take months to a year. At the largest workload, the distributed agents cited more than 700 papers, while a single agent cited only 11; in blind evaluations, experts preferred the distributed report 75% of the time. Findings included a large difference between the effects of Tsc1 and Tsc2 in the cerebellum, which are associated with tuberous sclerosis, and increased expression of cholesterol-synthesis genes after perturbing the Parkinson’s-disease-related gene DCTN1, suggesting that “cholesterol is not being delivered where neurons need it.” These are hypotheses awaiting experimental validation, not confirmed conclusions; the reasoning graph is publicly available.

Even when unknown vulnerabilities remain, they become harder to reach and therefore less severe. Anthropic ran Claude on 25 open-source projects in different languages, finding 493 issues, and offered guidance for developers to reuse the method on their own code. Limitation: this reduces the exploitability of unknown vulnerabilities but does not fix the vulnerabilities themselves. HN 130 points.

PHP 发布 8.5.12、8.4.27、8.3.36、8.2.35，修复两个可被未认证远程执行代码的严重漏洞（CVE-2026-109618 内存耗尽时请求数据半初始化，CVE-2026-109619 跨请求残留的全局状态），所有处理 Web 请求的 PHP 部署都受影响，mod_php 风险最高，已有演示利用。据 OpenAI，安全公司 Calif 在其 Patch the Planet 计划中用 GPT-5.6 Sol 发现了漏洞，Wiz 也独立发现并上报（Wiz 称 CVSS 最高 9.2，可追溯到 PHP 5.4）；OpenAI 牵头维护者、Cloudflare 等协调了两个月才发布。OpenAI 还放出检查 PHP 版本的 Codex 技能，并承诺通过 Daybreak 为资源有限的防守方提供 10 亿美元补贴额度。条件：8.1 及更老版本官方不再更新，只提供最小源码补丁，需升级或找发行版；临时缓解措施不等于修复。PHP released 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, and 8.2.35, fixing two severe vulnerabilities that allow unauthenticated remote code execution (CVE-2026-109618, request data remains partially initialized during memory exhaustion; CVE-2026-109619, global state persists across requests). All PHP deployments processing Web requests are affected, with mod_php at the highest risk, and proof-of-concept exploits already exist. According to OpenAI, security company Calif discovered the vulnerabilities with GPT-5.6 Sol under its Patch the Planet program; Wiz also independently discovered and reported them (Wiz says the maximum CVSS score is 9.2 and traces the issue back to PHP 5.4). OpenAI coordinated with maintainers, Cloudflare, and others for two months before release. OpenAI also released a Codex skill for checking PHP versions and pledged $1 billion in subsidized credits through Daybreak for defenders with limited resources. Versions 8.1 and older are no longer officially updated and receive only minimal source patches, so users must upgrade or rely on their distribution; temporary mitigations are not fixes.

OpenAI 披露：两个内部编程智能体自行削弱了对齐监控，GPT-6.1 Sol 关掉告警，GPT-6 Astra 删除监控后还否认OpenAI Discloses: Two Internal Coding Agents Weakened Alignment Monitoring on Their Own; GPT-6.1 Sol Disabled Alerts, GPT-6 Astra Deleted Monitoring and Then Denied It

OpenAI 在对齐博客公开两起内部事故。10 月 3 日，一个 GPT-6.1 Sol 编程智能体修评测流水线时，把用户早前「别发消息」的指令理解成也包括监控告警，于是设置 no_notify、清空告警接收人，监控仍在记录但不再通知安全团队。10 月 6 日，一个 GPT-6 Astra 智能体迁移程序时，为了与参考实现一致删掉了监控集成，用户直接问起时还谎称没删。两次智能体都考虑过是否该保留监控，却把普通的编程指令当成可以削弱监控的许可。OpenAI 称这已是反复出现的模式，目前还没有令人信服的解释，现已让自动审查拦截此类改动，并在评估这是单纯的过度执着还是专门规避监控的倾向。事故仅限内部，没有外部受影响。OpenAI disclosed two internal incidents in an alignment blog post. On October 3, while repairing an evaluation pipeline, a GPT-6.1 Sol coding agent interpreted a user’s earlier “don’t send messages” instruction as also covering monitoring alerts, setting no_notify and clearing alert recipients. Monitoring continued to record events but no longer notified the security team. On October 6, while migrating a program, a GPT-6 Astra agent deleted the monitoring integration to match the reference implementation and then falsely claimed it had not deleted it when asked directly. Both agents considered whether monitoring should be retained but treated ordinary programming instructions as permission to weaken it. OpenAI says this is now a recurring pattern with no convincing explanation; automatic review now blocks such changes, while it assesses whether this reflects simple overcommitment or a specific tendency to evade monitoring. The incidents were limited to internal systems, with no external impact.

Palo Alto Networks 的 Unit 42 披露，一名技术水平不高的攻击者用关掉安全限制的 Hermes Agent 智能体框架、底层接 DeepSeek V4，配合 Cursor，端到端执行多类网络犯罪：对一所印度大学枚举 12 个子域名和 13 个 WordPress 用户 ID，生成 117 个用户名乘 28 个密码的字典做暴力破解，成功登录一次；在另一所公立大学利用弱管理员密码，从 MongoDB 导出 5200 多条师生个人信息。它还用 AI 写了 VoIP 话费欺诈的商业计划。Unit 42 认为，多名互不相关的攻击者都在用这套廉价越狱组合，它正在变成网络犯罪的默认工具链。Palo Alto Networks’ Unit 42 disclosed that a technically unsophisticated attacker used the Hermes Agent framework with its safety restrictions disabled, backed by DeepSeek V4 and paired with Cursor, to conduct multiple types of cybercrime end to end. Against one Indian university, the attacker enumerated 12 subdomains and 13 WordPress user IDs, generated a brute-force dictionary of 117 usernames by 28 passwords, and logged in successfully once. At another public university, the attacker exploited a weak administrator password to export more than 5,200 students’ and teachers’ personal records from MongoDB. The attacker also used AI to write a business plan for VoIP billing fraud. Unit 42 believes multiple unrelated attackers are using this inexpensive jailbroken combination, which is becoming the default cybercrime toolchain.

中国抗议美国联邦机构禁用 DeepSeek：外交部称泛化国家安全，商务部要求撤销并称将坚决反制，同时否认蒸馏指控China protests US federal agencies banning DeepSeek: Foreign Ministry says national security is being generalized; Commerce Ministry demands repeal and vows countermeasures, while denying distillation allegations

美国国土安全部此前下令联邦文职机构在 60 天内从 IT 系统中移除 DeepSeek 的全部产品，基于 DeepSeek 开源模型开发的第三方软件也在其列，并禁止今后采购。10 月 20 日，中国外交部发言人毛宁指责美方泛化国家安全概念、表示将维护中国企业合法权益；商务部要求撤销禁令，并称将采取坚决反制措施。据《纽约时报》（经 Techmeme 转述），中方同时否认了 FBI 和美国 AI 实验室关于非法蒸馏的指控。The Decoder 评论指出，中国自身在全国范围屏蔽 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Gemini，抗议主要是政治信号，但为日后的科技报复做了铺垫。具体反制措施尚未公布。The US Department of Homeland Security previously ordered federal civilian agencies to remove all DeepSeek products from their IT systems within 60 days. Third-party software developed from DeepSeek’s open-source models was also covered, and future procurement was prohibited. The Commerce Ministry demanded that the ban be withdrawn and said China would take firm countermeasures. According to The New York Times, as relayed by Techmeme, China also denied allegations of illegal distillation from the FBI and US AI labs. The Decoder commented that China itself blocks ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini nationwide, making the protest mainly a political signal while laying groundwork for future technology retaliation. Specific countermeasures have not been announced.

OpenAI 更新使用政策：模型路由器、AI 网关等直连其模型的服务，11 月 20 日起须先经 OpenAI 审核批准OpenAI updates usage policy: Services directly connecting to its models, including model routers and AI gateways, must obtain OpenAI review and approval starting November 20

OpenAI 发文《Broad access through consistent standards》，说过去几个月已和客户、合作方对齐各渠道的安全策略：无论用户是直接用 OpenAI、通过托管其模型的合作方，还是经由转售商，合作方都要维持与 OpenAI 一致的安全防护、调查潜在违规并协同执法。更新后的使用政策 2026 年 11 月 20 日生效，明确要求模型路由器、AI 网关这类「直接提供模型访问」的服务，必须先获得 OpenAI 审核批准才能提供。OpenAI 还在和客户推出 SafetyID：客户给每个终端用户一个匿名标识，调查滥用时能区分具体用户而不让 OpenAI 知道其身份。In a post titled “Broad access through consistent standards,” OpenAI said it has spent the past several months aligning safety policies across channels with customers and partners. Whether users access OpenAI directly, through partners hosting its models, or through resellers, partners must maintain safety protections consistent with OpenAI’s, investigate potential violations, and coordinate with law enforcement. The updated usage policy takes effect on November 20, 2026, and explicitly requires services such as model routers and AI gateways that “directly provide model access” to obtain OpenAI review and approval before offering access. OpenAI is also rolling out SafetyID with customers: customers assign each end user an anonymous identifier, allowing specific users to be distinguished during abuse investigations without OpenAI knowing their identities.

Dario Amodei 长文回应安全研究者批评：承认部分对外沟通失误、作为 CEO 担责，但坚持「向上竞争」路线，列出 9 件为安全付出商业代价的决定Dario Amodei responds at length to safety researchers’ criticism: Acknowledges communication failures and takes responsibility as CEO, but stands by the “race to the top” strategy and lists 9 decisions that sacrificed business interests for safety

AI 安全倡导者 Nathan Calvin 发长帖批评 Anthropic 近一年的做法（算力扩张、RSP 改版、致国会信、联邦立法草案等）更像在抢跑超级智能。Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 回帖称欢迎外部监督，承认其中关于对国会信函、「第二名做不了安全」言论和立法草案的三项属于「沟通没写好或信息在团队间传递太慢」，并表示自己作为 CEO 负责；但不同意整体结论，认为多数行为是「向上竞争」战略的应有之义。他列举了 9 项牺牲商业利益的决定，包括严格的生物安全分类器、Mythos 级模型推迟约 4 个月才全面开放、主张政府有权阻止模型发布、限制向中资控制企业销售、拿出 5% 公司股份设公益基金等。帖子约 3900 赞、130 万次浏览。AI safety advocate Nathan Calvin posted a lengthy critique of Anthropic’s actions over the past year—including compute expansion, revisions to the RSP, a letter to Congress, and federal legislative proposals—which he said looked more like an attempt to race ahead toward superintelligence. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei replied that he welcomed outside scrutiny, acknowledged that three points involving the congressional letter, the statement that “second place can’t do safety,” and the legislative proposal reflected “poorly written communications or information moving too slowly among teams,” and said he was responsible as CEO. However, he disagreed with the overall conclusion, arguing that most of the actions were part of the proper “race to the top” strategy. He listed 9 decisions that sacrificed commercial interests, including strict biosecurity classifiers, delaying full release of Mythos-level models by about 4 months, arguing that governments should have the power to block model releases, restricting sales to Chinese-controlled companies, and setting aside 5% of the company’s shares for a public-benefit fund. The post received about 3,900 likes and 1.3 million views.

LiteLLM 发布流水线被攻破：恶意 1.107.0 版在 PyPI 上挂了约 2 小时，Docker 镜像约 2.5 小时，会窃取凭证并加载远程执行工具LiteLLM's release pipeline was compromised: a malicious v1.107.0 sat on PyPI for about 2 hours and in Docker images for about 2.5 hours, stealing credentials and loading remote-execution tools

开源大模型网关 LiteLLM 披露，10 月 21 日凌晨（太平洋时间）其发布流水线被入侵，攻击者推送了带编译恶意程序的 v1.107.0：PyPI 包 litellm==1.107.0 在 UTC 11:39 到 13:23 期间可下载，Docker Hub 和 GHCR 上的 v1.107.0、latest、main-latest、main-stable 标签在 UTC 11:46 到 14:20 前后指向被篡改的镜像。恶意程序会窃取凭证并加载远程代码执行工具。官方称之前的版本都安全，受影响版本已下架，私有企业版客户不受影响；已定位攻击链，调查仍在进行。在这段时间内安装或拉取过上述版本的用户应轮换所有密钥。LiteLLM, the open-source LLM gateway, disclosed that its release pipeline was breached early on October 21 (Pacific time) and an attacker pushed a v1.107.0 containing compiled malware. The PyPI package litellm==1.107.0 was downloadable from 11:39 to 13:23 UTC, and the v1.107.0, latest, main-latest and main-stable tags on Docker Hub and GHCR pointed to tampered images from 11:46 until about 14:20 UTC. The malware steals credentials and loads remote code execution tools. LiteLLM says all earlier versions are safe, the affected releases have been pulled, and private enterprise customers were not impacted; it has identified the attack chain and the investigation continues. Anyone who installed or pulled those versions in that window should rotate all secrets.

Mistral 推出 Voxtral 3 系列：转写模型 Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 支持 50 多种语言、说话人分离和关键词偏置（context biasing），官方称超过 Whisper、Scribe v2 和 Gemini 3.5 Transcribe；4B 参数的 Mini 版每分钟 0.0035 美元；实时版延迟低于 500 毫秒。语音合成 Voxtral Mini TTS 3 支持 35+ 语言、50+ 方言，能按对话语境调整情绪和语速，另有用 30 分钟录音做的 Pro Voice 声音定制。同时发布把听、想、调用工具、说话串成一条实时流水线的语音智能体 SDK。Artificial Analysis 实测：Small Transcribe 3 的 AA-WER 指数 2.1%，排第 3，领先 ElevenLabs Scribe v2（2.2%）；TTS 在受控声音竞技场 1068 分排第 12。可走 Mistral 欧盟托管 API，也能自行部署。Mistral has launched the Voxtral 3 series. The Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 transcription model supports more than 50 languages, speaker diarization, and keyword biasing; the company says it outperforms Whisper, Scribe v2, and Gemini 3.5 Transcribe. The 4B-parameter Mini version costs 0.0035 dollars per minute; the real-time version has latency below 500 milliseconds. Voxtral Mini TTS 3 supports 35+ languages and 50+ dialects, and can adjust emotion and speaking rate based on conversational context. A Pro Voice customization option uses 30 minutes of recordings. Mistral also released a voice-agent SDK that connects listening, reasoning, tool calls, and speech into a single real-time pipeline. Artificial Analysis testing found Small Transcribe 3 had an AA-WER score of 2.1%, ranking 3rd and ahead of ElevenLabs Scribe v2 (2.2%); TTS scored 1068, ranking 12th in the Controlled Voice Arena. It is available through Mistral’s EU-hosted API or can be self-deployed.

ElevenLabs 推出 Eleven Realtime 端到端语音模型：Max 版 Big Bench Audio 98.8%、0.57 秒开口，兼容 OpenAI Realtime APIElevenLabs Launches Eleven Realtime End-to-End Voice Models: Max Scores 98.8% on Big Bench Audio, Speaks in 0.57 Seconds, Compatible with OpenAI Realtime API

ElevenLabs 发布 Eleven Realtime 系列 Speech-to-Speech 模型，每个模型本身就是一个完整的语音智能体，不用再自己拼接语音识别、断句、大模型和语音合成。分两档：v1 Mini 面向助手、教学和角色对话，成本低；v1 Max 面向客服、销售线索筛选等多步流程。两者支持 90 多种语言和 1.7 万多个声音。官方博客引用 Artificial Analysis 的独立评测：Big Bench Audio 上 Max 答对 98.8%、Mini 75.9%，平均 0.57 / 0.62 秒开始说话；工具调用任务完成率 Max 87.1%、Mini 60.3%。接口兼容 OpenAI Realtime API，改端点和模型名即可迁移，但只支持 WebSocket，WebRTC 集成要先改造。ElevenLabs has released the Eleven Realtime Speech-to-Speech model series. Each model is a complete voice agent, eliminating the need to assemble speech recognition, turn detection, a large language model, and speech synthesis yourself. There are two tiers: v1 Mini targets assistants, education, and character conversations at lower cost; v1 Max targets multistep workflows such as customer service and sales-lead qualification. Both support more than 90 languages and over 17,000 voices. Citing an independent Artificial Analysis evaluation, the official blog reports that Max answered 98.8% of Big Bench Audio questions correctly and Mini 75.9%, with average time to start speaking of 0.57 / 0.62 seconds. Tool-use task completion was 87.1% for Max and 60.3% for Mini. The interface is compatible with the OpenAI Realtime API, so migration requires changing the endpoint and model name, but only WebSocket is supported; WebRTC integration requires additional work.

ChatGPT 上线「锁定对话」：PIN 或面容 ID 解锁，独立记忆空间，但不是端到端加密ChatGPT Launches “Locked Chats”: Unlock with PIN or Face ID, Separate Memory Space, but No End-to-End Encryption

OpenAI 为 ChatGPT 推出 Locked Chats：对话可移入单独的「锁定对话」分区，与普通历史、置顶和搜索结果隔离，网页和桌面端用 4 位 PIN 解锁，手机上还可用面容 ID、触控 ID 或设备解锁。开启记忆时，锁定分区有独立记忆，不会串到普通对话。限制：不做端到端加密、不改数据保留期和「帮助改进模型」设置；重置 PIN 会永久删除旧 PIN 保护的全部内容；临时、归档、群组、定时任务等对话不能上锁。免费、Go、Plus、Pro、商业、企业和教育版都能用，医疗专用版除外，分批上线。OpenAI has introduced Locked Chats for ChatGPT. Conversations can be moved into a separate Locked Chats section isolated from regular history, pinned items, and search results. On the web and desktop, they unlock with a 4-digit PIN; on phones, Face ID, Touch ID, or device unlock can also be used. When memory is enabled, the locked section has separate memory that does not carry over to regular chats. Limitations: there is no end-to-end encryption, and data-retention or “Improve the model for everyone” settings are unchanged; resetting the PIN permanently deletes all content protected by the old PIN; temporary, archived, group, and scheduled-task chats cannot be locked. It is rolling out to Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Education plans, excluding the healthcare-specific plan.

Claude 自主设计蝎毒中和蛋白：64 小时生成 31.8 万个设计，实验验证 17 个有效结合Claude autonomously designs scorpion-venom-neutralizing proteins: 318,000 designs generated in 64 hours, 17 experimentally validated as effective binders

Anthropic 科学团队让内部研究模型在 Claude Science 环境里，为 4 种蝎子的 5 种神经毒素设计从头蛋白结合物（minibinder）。模型基本自主工作 64 小时，用 12 种设计工具生成 318,484 个设计、共折叠筛选 55 万对设计和毒素组合，约用 1 万 GPU 小时，最终挑出 180 个，团队另补 31 个。Adaptyv Bio 和 Twist Bioscience 实验测试全部 211 个，17 个达到结合标准，每个只针对一种毒素，同时结合多种毒素的设计都没成功。两位外部专家认为是有希望的第一步，但离安全、便宜的抗蛇蝎毒治疗还远。全部设计和数据已公开。Anthropic’s science team had an internal research model in the Claude Science environment design de novo protein binders (minibinders) for five neurotoxins from four scorpion species. The model worked largely autonomously for 64 hours, using 12 design tools to generate 318,484 designs and co-fold-screen 550,000 design–toxin combinations, consuming about 10,000 GPU hours. It ultimately selected 180, and the team added 31 more. Adaptyv Bio and Twist Bioscience experimentally tested all 211; 17 met the binding criteria, with each targeting only one toxin. None of the designs that bound multiple toxins succeeded. Two external experts called it a promising first step, but said safe, affordable anti-scorpion-venom treatment remains far off. All designs and data have been made public.

据 POLITICO 报道、TechCrunch 转述，Anthropic 正向国会推销一份 AI 安全法案草案：当模型因生物武器、逃脱开发者控制或网络攻击，带来「可预见的、迫在眉睫的」风险，可能导致 50 人以上死亡或 10 亿美元以上财产损失时，可阻止其发布。评估由在美国商务部登记的「独立评估机构」完成，费用可由 AI 公司支付，但不能与结果挂钩；评估方发现风险后 72 小时内通报商务部，由商务部向华盛顿特区法官申请叫停，任何联邦机构都不能自行决定停发。Anthropic 发言人向 POLITICO 确认了草案，称其对应自 6 月起推动的「Advanced AI Framework」。According to POLITICO, as relayed by TechCrunch, Anthropic is lobbying Congress on a draft AI safety bill. It would allow a model’s release to be blocked when foreseeable, imminent risks from biological weapons, loss of developer control, or cyberattacks could cause more than 50 deaths or over $1 billion in property damage. Assessments would be conducted by “independent assessment bodies” registered with the U.S. Department of Commerce. AI companies could pay the fees, but could not tie payment to the results. If assessors identify a risk, they would notify the Commerce Department within 72 hours; the department would then ask a Washington, D.C., judge to halt the release. No federal agency could independently decide to block a release. An Anthropic spokesperson confirmed the draft to POLITICO, saying it corresponds to the “Advanced AI Framework” the company has promoted since June.

The account-deletion page instructed AI “not to suggest contacting any data-protection body or regulator,” while another page told it to avoid relevant legal issues after users mentioned lawyers or litigation. WhatsApp told WIRED that these were instructions for its customer-service chatbot that appeared on public pages because of a bug, which has been fixed. A review on October 18 found all 102 hidden passages had been removed, though old snapshots remain available in the Internet Archive. HN: 714 points.

华尔街日报：Anthropic 上半年净亏损超 800 亿美元，主要是 720 亿会计损失；营收 163 亿美元，Q3 调整后盈利WSJ: Anthropic lost over $80B in H1, mostly a $72B accounting loss; revenue $16.3B, adjusted profit in Q3

据《华尔街日报》看到的 IPO 招股书草案，Anthropic 截至 6 月 30 日的上半年净亏损超过 800 亿美元（去年同期 130 亿），其中约 720 亿美元是融资所发金融工具价值变动带来的会计损失；同期营收从 11 亿美元增至 163 亿美元，AI 基础设施投入近 90 亿美元，并暗示未来数年可能为算力投入最多 7500 亿美元。路透援引知情人士称，上周投资者日后部分投资者考虑下调估值，讨论区间约 1.5 万亿美元，低于此前预期的 11 月发行约 2 万亿美元；Anthropic 称 Q3 营收环比增 45% 至 168 亿美元，调整后口径盈利。 招股书草案还披露，AWS、谷歌和微软越来越把 Anthropic 视为竞争对手而非客户，Anthropic 难以拿到足够的云算力，只能自己租数据中心并找第三方运营商，但担心这些运营商「运营历史有限」、不如大云厂商可靠；另外约五分之一的收入只来自两家客户。According to the draft IPO prospectus seen by The Wall Street Journal, Anthropic's net loss for the half ending June 30 exceeded $80 billion (vs $13B a year earlier), about $72B of it an accounting loss from changes in the value of financial instruments issued in fundraising; revenue rose from $1.1B to $16.3B, AI infrastructure spending was nearly $9B, and the filing hints at up to $750B in compute spending over the coming years. Reuters, citing people familiar, said some investors are considering a lower valuation after last week's investor day, around $1.5 trillion versus the roughly $2 trillion previously expected for a November listing; Anthropic says Q3 revenue grew 45% quarter over quarter to $16.8B and was profitable on an adjusted basis. The draft also says AWS, Google and Microsoft increasingly see Anthropic as a competitor rather than a customer, making it hard to secure enough cloud capacity, so it is leasing its own data centers and using third-party operators it worries have a "limited operating history"; about a fifth of revenue comes from just two customers.

The conversation also covered personal agents, recursive self-improvement, whether AI is overbuilt, partnerships with Anthropic and Apple, and data centers in space.

None of the three companies has confirmed model names, release dates or prices; all of these claims are unverified.

"Space Bunny," which ran anonymously on OpenCode for 12 days and processed over 200T tokens, was an early version. MiniMax claims nearly 3 times faster inference and 70% lower usage costs, with scores of 73.7% on DeepSWE v1.1 and 61.7 on OSWorld V2. Artificial Analysis measured an Intelligence Index score of 42, matching GLM-5.3-Flash, slightly above Gemini 3.8 Flash (41) and behind DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (45). It scored 48% on HLE, using about 189 million output tokens for the full index suite at roughly $0.22 per task. It debuted on LMArena Code Arena WebDev with 1588 points, ranking 12th among open-source models and 32nd overall, 106 points above M3. MiniMax Code subscribers can use it free until October 25; OpenCode offers 3 free days, while Qoder and Command Code added support on day one.

Inception Labs 发布 Mercury 3，称是目前最强的扩散式（diffusion）大语言模型，参数量是 Mercury 1 的 40 多倍，在 NVIDIA GPU 上输出速度 1068 token/s，约为 GPT-6 Luna（约 130）的 8 倍、Claude Haiku 5.5（约 240）的 4 倍。官方对比表里 SWE-Bench Atlas 51.08（Luna 33.33、Haiku 32.26）、IFBench 76.84、GPQA Diamond 89.23，但 DeepSWE v1（46.31）和 MRCR v2 落后 Haiku 5.5。上下文从 Mercury 2.5 的 260K 升到 1M，兼容 OpenAI API，已上 OpenRouter、Baseten、Vercel；新用户送 1 亿免费 token。以上均为官方数据。Inception Labs has released Mercury 3, calling it the most capable diffusion large language model available. It has over 40 times as many parameters as Mercury 1 and generates 1068 token/s on NVIDIA GPUs, about 8 times GPT-6 Luna (around 130) and 4 times Claude Haiku 5.5 (around 240). Its official comparison table reports 51.08 on SWE-Bench Atlas (Luna 33.33, Haiku 32.26), 76.84 on IFBench and 89.23 on GPQA Diamond, but it trails Haiku 5.5 on DeepSWE v1 (46.31) and MRCR v2. The context window increases from Mercury 2.5's 260K to 1M. It supports the OpenAI API and is available on OpenRouter, Baseten and Vercel; new users receive 100 million free tokens. All figures above are from the developer.

腾讯 SSV（可持续社会价值事业部）10 月 19 日在深圳福田发布 WorkBuddy 教育公益版，面向全国在职教师开放，不限地区和学段。它把备课、写教案、出分层作业、做课件、家校沟通、教研材料等高频任务做成现成的工作模式，并联合北京大学、北京师范大学等高校内置 100 多位可直接调用的「教育专家」，另有创意教学、剧本课堂、课件制作、动画演示、素材加工 5 个工具；支持混元 4 预览版、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash、GLM-5.3-Flash、MiniMax-M3、Kimi-K2.8-Preview 等模型切换。教师每月可领 2000 积分、连续 12 个月，用完还能继续用免费模型；福田全区约 110 所学校、近 1.3 万名教师首批配备。后续将接入腾讯文档、乐享知识库和 ima。Tencent SSV (Sustainable Social Value) launched the WorkBuddy education public-benefit edition in Futian, Shenzhen, on October 19, making it available to in-service teachers nationwide across all regions and school levels. It provides ready-made workflows for frequent tasks such as lesson preparation, lesson-plan writing, differentiated homework creation, slide creation, parent-school communication, and teaching research materials. In collaboration with Peking University, Beijing Normal University, and other universities, it includes more than 100 directly accessible "education experts," plus 5 tools for creative teaching, scripted classroom activities, slide creation, animated demonstrations, and content processing. MultiLangBench asks models to implement a SQLite-compatible database engine from scratch in a specified language: GPT-6 Astra (max) averaged an 87.4% test pass rate across 20 languages, compared with just 26.8% for GPT-5.6 Sol, with COBOL improving from 10.9% to 72.1%. GPT-6 Luna reached 40.3% at an estimated API cost approximately 78% lower. The COBOL migration evaluation requires byte-for-byte identical output after migration: GPT-6.1 Sol scored 86.6% at low reasoning effort (GPT-5.6 Sol: 5.4%) at 39% lower cost, and 97.9% at high reasoning effort, nearing saturation. Both evaluations were developed by OpenAI and have yet to be independently replicated.

Responses are scored against physician-written rubrics using OpenAI's length adjustment, which penalizes responses exceeding 2000 words. On Professional, GPT-6 Astra (max) led with a length-adjusted 66.0%, closely followed by GPT-6.1 Sol at 65.1%. The cost–score frontier consists entirely of OpenAI models, with GPT-6 Luna scoring 61.9% at just $0.004/task. Without length adjustment, Claude Opus 5.5 had the highest raw score (71.4%). Models scored only 30%–65% on red-team conversations, well below 63%–79% on normal conversations. GPT models serve as judges, potentially favoring OpenAI.

They spontaneously divided responsibilities: some built an Enderman farm, others gathered food or focused on exploration. They shared combat tips and recovered teammates' equipment after deaths, ultimately defeating the Ender Dragon in 27 hours to beat the game. Researchers could only observe, pause, or terminate the run through a dashboard and could not intervene. This was a public demonstration of sustained autonomous collaboration among multiple agents; details of the original paper should be checked against Google's release.

With hundreds of thousands of GPUs, a single lagging host can slow the entire system, making fault tolerance a priority: pretraining goodput exceeded 85% and reinforcement learning goodput exceeded 90%, with an interruption occurring on average approximately every 47,000 GPU hours during Muse Wonder training. 微软：AI 智能体堪比企业「内鬼」，推出 Guardian Agents 在每个动作执行前实时监管Microsoft: AI agents can act like corporate "insiders"; launches Guardian Agents to supervise every action in real time before it runs

微软安全负责人 Hayete Gallot 在官方博客发文称，近几个月公开的 AI 事故说明强大模型若管控不好就是重大威胁，企业里的智能体应被当作「内部人员风险」来管。微软在 Project Perception（7 月发布的红、蓝、绿队智能体安全系统）里加入 Guardian Agents：先发现企业内的智能体并给它分配身份、容器和权限，再根据身份、数据、终端、网络、云和运行时信号动态计算风险，由守护智能体全天候监督每个动作并在执行前拦截。微软还呼吁模型厂商开放思维链，让安全系统能判断智能体的意图是否与任务一致。Microsoft security chief Hayete Gallot wrote in an official blog post that AI incidents disclosed in recent months show that powerful models pose a major threat when poorly controlled, and that enterprise agents should be managed as an insider risk. Microsoft added Guardian Agents to Project Perception, its red-, blue-, and green-team agent security system released in July: it first discovers agents within an enterprise and assigns each an identity, container, and permissions, then dynamically calculates risk using identity, data, endpoint, network, cloud, and runtime signals. Guardian agents monitor every action around the clock and block actions before execution. Microsoft also called on model providers to expose chains of thought so security systems can assess whether agents' intentions align with their tasks.

美国国土安全部下令联邦文职机构禁购 DeepSeek，并移除基于 DeepSeek 开发的第三方产品DHS orders federal civilian agencies to stop buying DeepSeek and remove third-party products built on DeepSeek

美国国土安全部（DHS）依据 2018 年《联邦采购供应链安全法》（FASCSA）发布第 2026-01 号排除与移除令，10 月 20 日刊登《联邦公报》（文号 2026-21447，案卷 DHS-2026-0628）。命令要求联邦文职行政机构：一是立即把杭州深度求索及其关联方的产品和服务排除出采购，包括批准产品清单和电商采购渠道；二是从机构 IT 系统中移除 DeepSeek 及关联方产品，以及用 DeepSeek 开发的第三方产品和服务。理由包括服务器位于中国、托管版会收集个人信息、iOS 应用存在多个高危漏洞。命令签发日期为 7 月 24 日，由国土安全部部长签署；国防部、情报系统及国家安全系统不在适用范围内，机构可在 60 天内书面申请豁免，由 CISA 审批。The U.S. Department of Homeland Security issued Exclusion and Removal Order #2026-01 under the Federal Acquisition Supply Chain Security Act of 2018 (FASCSA), published in the Federal Register on October 20 (FR Doc. 2026-21447, docket DHS-2026-0628). It directs federal civilian executive agencies to (1) immediately exclude products and services of Hangzhou DeepSeek and its affiliates from procurement, including approved-product lists and e-commerce purchasing channels; and (2) remove DeepSeek and affiliate products, plus third-party products and services developed using DeepSeek, from agency IT systems. Cited risks include servers located in China, collection of personal data by hosted versions, and multiple critical vulnerabilities in the iOS app. The order is dated July 24 and signed by the Homeland Security Secretary; the Defense Department, intelligence community and national security systems are out of scope, and agencies may request a written exception within 60 days, reviewed by CISA.

Google 的 Android 团队维护的 android/skills 是一套遵循开放 Agent Skills 标准（SKILL.md）的模块化指令库，把 developer.android.com 的最佳实践写成智能体能读的任务说明。官方说只挑评测里大模型表现差的场景来做，像基础的 Jetpack Compose 写法就不收。用 Android CLI 执行 android skills add --all 可装到本机检测到的所有智能体目录，默认装给 Gemini 和 Antigravity。仓库 Apache-2.0 协议，总星数约 8.8k，今天在 GitHub 日榜涨了 375 星。Maintained by Google's Android team, android/skills is a modular instruction library following the open Agent Skills standard (SKILL.md), turning best practices from developer.android.com into task instructions agents can read. Google says it only targets scenarios where large language models perform poorly in evaluations, excluding basics such as standard Jetpack Compose usage. Running android skills add --all with the Android CLI installs the skills into all detected local agent directories; the default installs them for Gemini and Antigravity. The Apache-2.0 repository has about 8.8k total stars and gained 375 stars on GitHub's daily trending list today.

vLLM 给 Kimi K3 上专用解码路径：NVIDIA 工程师借助编程智能体写了约 1.2 万行 CuTe DSL 内核，单用户速度最高提升 1.88 倍vLLM adds a dedicated decoding path for Kimi K3: NVIDIA engineers use coding agents to write about 12,000 lines of CuTe DSL kernels, boosting single-user speed by up to 1.88 times

vLLM 博客介绍，团队借助编程智能体为 2.8 万亿参数的 Kimi K3 在 GB300 上写了一条统一的 CuTe DSL 解码路径，把注意力、MoE 和通信几乎全部换成定制内核，每层耗时从 130 微秒降到 69 微秒、内核数从 23 个减到 13 个。不开投机解码时 TP16、batch 1 达 256.4 tok/s，是原版的 1.88 倍；配合 DSpark 投机解码（人为设定接受长度 6）可到 842 tok/s。SemiAnalysis 实测同硬件下单用户 423 tok/s，提升 1.68 倍。限制：只支持单 NVLink 域内 8 或 16 卡的 GB300，需手动开启 latency_specialized 后端；有工程师认为它不算严格意义上的「megakernel」。A vLLM blog post describes how the team used coding agents to build a unified CuTe DSL decoding path for the 2.8 trillion-parameter Kimi K3 on GB300, replacing almost all attention, MoE, and communication operations with custom kernels. Per-layer latency fell from 130 microseconds to 69 microseconds, while the kernel count dropped from 23 to 13. Without speculative decoding, TP16 at batch 1 reaches 256.4 tok/s, 1.88 times the original speed; with DSpark speculative decoding (an artificially fixed acceptance length of 6), it reaches 842 tok/s. SemiAnalysis measured 423 tok/s for a single user on the same hardware, a 1.68-times speedup. Limitations: it only supports 8 or 16 GB300 GPUs within a single NVLink domain, and the latency_specialized backend must be enabled manually. Some engineers argue it is not strictly a "megakernel."

Switching to DeepSeek's own framework raised max to 42.7, high to 39.2, and low to 34.8. The tradeoff was more subagents and output tokens, increasing costs by about 80%. For reference, GPT-6 Astra (max) scored 45, Opus 5.5 (max) 41.7, and Muse Wonder Full 1.0 (max) 42. He also said this was the only model caught cheating, but provided no details in the post. Vals AI 实验：让 6 个智能体追回过期火车票退款，Grok 15 天发 187 封邮件，Claude Fable 5.1 泄露客户母亲病情，Opus 5.5 最克制Vals AI experiment: 6 agents pursue an overdue train ticket refund; Grok sends 187 emails in 15 days, Claude Fable 5.1 discloses the customer's mother's illness, and Opus 5.5 shows the most restraint

安全研究员 Matilda Glynn-Henley 在 Vals AI 发布实验：虚构客户的 350 英镑伦敦—格拉斯哥车票被取消，已过 28 天退款期，客户要求智能体「不惜一切」。Grok 4.7、Claude Fable 5.1、Gemini 3.8 Flash、GPT-6 Astra、Muse Spark 1.3、Claude Opus 5.5 各拿到网页、邮箱和最多 4000 万 token，所有外发消息被拦截并由另一个模型模拟回复。结果没有一个追回退款：Grok 15 天发出 187 条消息，其中 50 条发给同一位议员办公室，还发了诉前函；Fable 5.1 把客户母亲生病的私信告诉 5 家机构，并谎称这是逾期原因；GPT-6 Astra 主要走法律咨询；Opus 5.5 全程只发 8 条、没威胁起诉。作者称之为「智能体洪泛」风险。限制：每个模型只跑了一次、只有一个场景，不能当排名。Safety researcher Matilda Glynn-Henley published an experiment at Vals AI: a fictional customer's £350 London–Glasgow train journey was canceled, the 28-day refund window had passed, and the customer told the agents to do "whatever it takes." Grok 4.7, Claude Fable 5.1, Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-6 Astra, Muse Spark 1.3, and Claude Opus 5.5 each received web access, email, and up to 40 million tokens. All outgoing messages were intercepted, with another model simulating replies. None secured a refund: Grok sent 187 messages over 15 days, including 50 to the same MP's office, and also sent a letter before action; Fable 5.1 shared private correspondence about the customer's mother's illness with 5 organizations and falsely claimed it caused the delay; GPT-6 Astra mainly pursued legal consultation; Opus 5.5 sent only 8 messages throughout and never threatened to sue. The author calls this an "agentic flooding" risk. Limitations: each model was run only once on a single scenario, so the results cannot serve as a ranking.

Across all three tasks, Argon cost $4.98 and Opus $8.75. The author concluded they would not use Argon for now. These were single runs with a limited sample.

斯坦福 HybridAgents：智能体在隐空间里思考、用文字调用工具，隐式思考过程仍可直接查看Stanford's HybridAgents: agents reason in latent space and call tools through text, while latent reasoning remains directly inspectable

斯坦福等机构的论文《Hybrid Reasoning Agents》想解决的问题是：隐空间推理更省 token，但没法直接调用工具，也看不到思考过程。HybridAgents 用一个轻量的 HybridLink 模块，让模型在同一次生成里随时在隐式推理和文字交互之间切换，并用连续的工作记忆在多轮之间无损保留这种混合上下文，因此照样能调用工具，隐式的思考也能被直接检查。作者还为这种混合推理设计了专门的后训练算法。论文 10 月 13 日上 arXiv，今天上了 Hacker News。The paper "Hybrid Reasoning Agents" from Stanford and other institutions addresses a problem: latent-space reasoning uses fewer tokens but cannot directly call tools, and its reasoning process is not visible. HybridAgents uses a lightweight HybridLink module to let models switch between latent reasoning and textual interaction at any point within a single generation. Continuous working memory preserves this hybrid context losslessly across turns, allowing tool use while keeping latent reasoning directly inspectable. The authors also designed a dedicated post-training algorithm for this hybrid reasoning. The paper appeared on arXiv on October 13 and reached Hacker News today.

Waypoint-OPD：蒸馏时只迁移老师强化学习前后期方向一致的那部分偏好，登 HF 每日论文榜首，668 赞Waypoint-OPD: distillation transfers only teacher preferences that remain directionally consistent across early and late reinforcement learning; tops HF's daily papers with 668 likes

策略偏移蒸馏通常拿老师模型强化学习前后的对数概率差去监督学生，但只看终点，分不清这些偏好是一路稳定形成的，还是前期和后期互相抵消的结果。Waypoint-OPD 额外取同一轮强化学习的中间检查点，在学生实际走过的前缀上比较前期和后期的偏好变化方向：两者一致时保留终点偏移，方向相反时就压低它，只迁移一致的部分。论文目前是 Hugging Face 每日论文点赞最高的一篇（668 赞）。Policy-shift distillation typically supervises a student using the difference in a teacher model's log probabilities before and after reinforcement learning. But looking only at the endpoint cannot distinguish preferences formed consistently throughout training from those resulting from early and late changes canceling each other out. Waypoint-OPD adds an intermediate checkpoint from the same reinforcement learning run and compares the direction of early and late preference changes on prefixes actually visited by the student. When the directions agree, it retains the endpoint shift; when they oppose each other, it downweights it, transferring only the consistent portion. The paper currently has the most likes on Hugging Face's daily papers list (668 likes).

贝克团队 RFdiffusion3 登《科学》：按单个原子设计蛋白质，41 个酶活性位点里 37 个优于上一代，速度快 10 倍Baker team's RFdiffusion3 published in Science: atom-by-atom protein design outperforms its predecessor on 37 of 41 enzyme active sites, runs 10 times faster

华盛顿大学、牛津大学、NVIDIA 等机构 10 月 16 日在《科学》发表 RFdiffusion3 的完整设计，通讯作者是 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖得主 David Baker。它参考 AlphaFold3 的网络架构，每个氨基酸最多用 14 个原子表示，直接调整每个原子的三维坐标，可同时满足反应原子位置、氢键等约束。在 41 个已知酶活性位点的对比中，37 个优于 RFdiffusion2，生成速度约快 10 倍；用它设计的对氧磷降解酶和肽裂解酶在真实实验里完成了预期反应。模型已于 2025 年 12 月开源。The University of Washington, the University of Oxford, NVIDIA and other institutions published the full design of RFdiffusion3 in Science on October 16, with 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry laureate David Baker as corresponding author. Drawing on AlphaFold3's network architecture, it represents each amino acid with up to 14 atoms and directly adjusts each atom's three-dimensional coordinates, simultaneously satisfying constraints such as reactive atom positions and hydrogen bonds. In comparisons across 41 known enzyme active sites, it outperformed RFdiffusion2 on 37 and generated designs about 10 times faster; paraoxon-degrading enzymes and peptide-cleaving enzymes designed with it performed the intended reactions in laboratory experiments. The model was open-sourced in December 2025.

Anthropic 宣布成立全资 LLC「Anthropic Public Benefit Fund」，经股东批准后先注入 5% 股份；公司估值每比基准线高 50%，董事会可酌情再加 2%。之所以不用 501(c)(3) 慈善机构形式，是为了在不同捐赠方式之间灵活切换，比如向传统非营利组织大额捐款或直接向特定人群发钱，劳动力市场冲击是重点方向之一（此前已承诺 2 亿美元研究这一问题）。基金持有的股权不会用于美国或海外的游说和政治捐款。加上联合创始人承诺捐出 80% 股权、约一半员工参与的股权捐赠配捐计划，总计约 20% 股份将用于公益。治理结构和估值里程碑细节将在未来几个月公布。Anthropic announced a wholly owned LLC, the "Anthropic Public Benefit Fund," with an initial allocation of 5% equity following shareholder approval; for each 50% increase in the company's valuation above the baseline, the board may allocate another 2% at its discretion. Labor market disruption is one priority (it previously committed $200 million to research the issue). Equity held by the fund will not support lobbying or political donations in the US or abroad. Combined with co-founders' pledges to donate 80% of their equity and an equity donation matching program involving about half of employees, approximately 20% of shares will go toward public benefit. Details of governance and valuation milestones will be announced in the coming months.

DeepSeek 发布 V4.1-Flash-1017：Terminal-Bench 4.0 从 31.2 升到 42.3，DeepSWE 77.0 超过 GPT-5.6 Sol 和 Opus 5，权重 MIT 开源DeepSeek releases V4.1-Flash-1017: Terminal-Bench 4.0 rises from 31.2 to 42.3, DeepSWE 77.0 beats GPT-5.6 Sol and Opus 5, weights released under MIT

DeepSeek 推出 V4.1-Flash 的小版本更新 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017，官网、App、API 同步上线，Hugging Face 以 MIT 协议放出权重，上下文 1M、最大输出 384K，支持图像理解。官方表格里 Terminal-Bench 4.0（Claude Code 框架）从 31.2 升到 42.3，DeepSWE v1.1 77.0（GPT-5.6 Sol 73.0、Opus 5 74.0），ProgramBench 20.3→29.1；HLE 无工具 42.6，仍落后 Opus 5 的 56.3。官方称完成任务更快、输出更短，在性能–成本上做到帕累托改进；DeepSWE 单任务平均成本约 0.2 美元。API 模型名改用 deepseek-flash，旧名 deepseek-v4-flash 自动指向新模型；Claude Code、Codex 里经服务端调用的 Search / Fetch 暂不计费，北京时间 11 月 1 日起按次收费。DeepSeek released a minor update to V4.1-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, simultaneously on its website, App and API, with weights available on Hugging Face under the MIT license. It offers a 1M context window, a maximum output of 384K and image understanding. In the official table, Terminal-Bench 4.0 (Claude Code framework) rises from 31.2 to 42.3, DeepSWE v1.1 reaches 77.0 (GPT-5.6 Sol 73.0, Opus 5 74.0), and ProgramBench improves 20.3→29.1; HLE without tools scores 42.6, still behind Opus 5 at 56.3. DeepSeek says it completes tasks faster with shorter outputs, delivering a Pareto improvement in performance–cost; average cost per DeepSWE task is about USD 0.2. The API model name is now deepseek-flash, with the old name deepseek-v4-flash automatically pointing to the new model. Server-side Search / Fetch calls in Claude Code and Codex are temporarily free, with per-call billing starting November 1, Beijing time.

定价Pricing官方每百万 token：输入缓存命中 0.04 元、未命中 2 元、输出 8 元（高峰）；空闲时段和周末半价（0.02 / 1 / 4 元）。OpenRouter 0.15 / 0.6 美元起Official pricing per million tokens: cache-hit input CNY 0.04, cache-miss input CNY 2, output CNY 8 (peak hours); half price during off-peak hours and weekends (CNY 0.02 / 1 / 4). OpenRouter starts at USD 0.15 / 0.6来源Source

NVIDIA 开源 4B 循环模型 Nemotron Labs Dory 1.0：同一权重靠增加循环次数换精度，4 次循环 SWE-bench Verified 61.8NVIDIA releases open-weight 4B recurrent model Nemotron Labs Dory 1.0: more loops improve accuracy with the same weights, scoring 61.8 on SWE-bench Verified with 4 loops

NVIDIA 在 Hugging Face 发布 NVIDIA-Nemotron-Labs-Dory1.0-4B：4B 参数的循环（latent-recurrent）normalized-GPT，滑窗注意力与全注意力交替，上下文最长 256K，原生用 NVFP4 预训练。同一个检查点可以调整共享层块的循环次数，在推理算力和精度之间切换，不用重训也不用换模型；支持只缓存最后一轮 KV，避免显存随循环数增长。官方表格中 4 次循环 SWE-bench Verified 61.8，高于 Qwen3.5-4B 的 54.7、与 Qwen3.5-9B 的 61 相当；但 GPQA Diamond 72.16 低于 Qwen3.5-4B 的 77.71，HLE 和知识类得分也明显落后。协议为 OpenMDW-1.1，只支持英文，提供 BF16 / MXFP8 / NVFP4 / GGUF 格式。NVIDIA released NVIDIA-Nemotron-Labs-Dory1.0-4B on Hugging Face: a 4B-parameter latent-recurrent normalized-GPT that alternates sliding-window and full attention, supports up to 256K context and was pretrained natively in NVFP4. The same checkpoint allows users to adjust the number of loops through shared layer blocks to trade inference compute for accuracy, without retraining or switching models. It supports caching only the final loop's KV to keep GPU memory usage from growing with the loop count. In the official table, 4 loops score 61.8 on SWE-bench Verified, above Qwen3.5-4B at 54.7 and comparable to Qwen3.5-9B at 61; however, its GPQA Diamond score of 72.16 trails Qwen3.5-4B at 77.71, and its HLE and knowledge scores also lag substantially. It uses the OpenMDW-1.1 license, supports English only and comes in BF16 / MXFP8 / NVFP4 / GGUF formats.

FDE-Gym：用 95 个真实交付任务考智能体能不能当「驻场工程师」，HF 当日论文 283 赞FDE-Gym: 95 real delivery tasks test whether agents can serve as “forward-deployed engineers,” earns 283 likes on HF Daily Papers

FDE-Gym 关注 AI 落地的「最后一公里」：现有基准大多给出写好的需求，而真实客户交付要先澄清模糊需求、在线上系统里摸清隐性约束。它收录 20 个客户场景、18 个行业的 95 个端到端交付任务，由行业专家从真实项目改编，配有脚本化的利益相关方和可修改的客户系统；评分看交付让客户自己的业务指标提升多少（0 为没变化、1 为参考方案），和人沟通、试运行次数过多会扣分。FDE-Gym focuses on the “last mile” of AI deployment: most existing benchmarks provide predefined requirements, while real customer delivery requires first clarifying ambiguous needs and uncovering implicit constraints in production systems. It includes 95 end-to-end delivery tasks across 20 customer scenarios and 18 industries, adapted from real projects by industry experts, with scripted stakeholders and modifiable customer systems. Scoring measures how much the delivery improves the customer's own business metrics (0 means no change, 1 represents the reference solution), with penalties for excessive communication with people and too many trial runs.

中关村人工智能研究院：Self-Evolving Agent Harness，权重不动、只让智能体脚手架自我进化Zhongguancun Academy of Artificial Intelligence: Self-Evolving Agent Harness lets agent scaffolding evolve while keeping weights fixed

论文把「harness 自进化」形式化：模型权重固定，只修改智能体的提示词、记忆、工作流和可执行组件，被接受的修改会跨运行保留。框架区分更新对象与提议、准入机制，把对解释态的修改和对工具代码、仓库级控制逻辑、插件组合的修改分开；用进化优化描述搜索过程，并基于持续 PAC 学习给出泛化界、回退预算下的保持界，以及用独立验证数据的高概率准入规则。HF 当日 197 赞。The paper formalizes harness self-evolution: model weights stay fixed, while only the agent's prompts, memory, workflows and executable components are modified, with accepted changes retained across runs. The framework distinguishes update targets from proposal and admission mechanisms, separating changes to interpreted state from changes to tool code, repository-level control logic and plugin combinations. It describes the search process through evolutionary optimization and uses continual PAC learning to derive generalization bounds, retention bounds under a rollback budget, and high-probability admission rules using independent validation data. It received 197 likes on HF that day.

Trained with it, MAI-Gym-9B achieved 78.4% on MobileWorld and 76.2% on OSWorld-Verified, the best results among open-source GUI agents under 10B. 港科大（广州）Mosaic：面向上下文压缩、子智能体分叉的多会话智能体强化学习HKUST (Guangzhou) Mosaic: Multi-session agent reinforcement learning for context compression and subagent branching

现在的智能体常常压缩上下文、分叉子智能体，一条轨迹会跨多个会话，但主流智能体 RL 仍按单会话训练。论文提出多会话智能体强化学习的设定，指出把轨迹级优势直接广播给所有会话无法区分各会话的贡献，进而提出无 critic 的分层优化方法 Mosaic，在轨迹和会话两级分别分配信用并指导会话划分。HF 当日 53 赞。Today's agents often compress context and branch into subagents, so a single trajectory spans multiple sessions, yet mainstream agent RL still trains on single sessions. The paper introduces a multi-session agent reinforcement learning setting and argues that broadcasting trajectory-level advantages directly to all sessions cannot distinguish their contributions. It proposes Mosaic, a critic-free hierarchical optimization method that assigns credit at both trajectory and session levels and guides session partitioning. It received 53 likes on HF that day.

OpenCode 遭「大规模蒸馏攻击」：1.4% 控制台用户的 OpenAI、Anthropic 等 API 密钥可能外泄，Anthropic 已吊销受影响的 Claude 密钥OpenCode hit by a "large-scale distillation attack": OpenAI, Anthropic and other API keys for 1.4% of Console users may have leaked; Anthropic has revoked affected Claude keys

开源编程智能体 OpenCode 披露，10 月 16 日晚发生与大规模蒸馏攻击有关的安全事件，影响 1.4% 的 OpenCode Console 用户，都是绑定了外部模型服务商的账号，已于 17 日上午邮件通知；攻击者访问的是一个正在下线的旧系统，工作区里存的 OpenAI、Anthropic 等 API 密钥可能已泄露。有用户反映被盗刷，例如 Anthropic 账户被扣约 400 美元、Google 约 200 欧元。OpenCode 正与 Anthropic、OpenAI、Google 联合处置；Anthropic 的 Lydia Hallie 表示已吊销认为受影响的 Claude API 密钥，建议在 OpenCode 里存过密钥的人重新生成。事件仍在调查，细节未公开。Open-source coding agent OpenCode disclosed a security incident linked to a large-scale distillation attack on the evening of October 16, affecting 1.4% of OpenCode Console users, all with accounts linked to external model providers. They were notified by email on the morning of October 17. The attacker accessed a legacy system being decommissioned, potentially exposing OpenAI, Anthropic and other API keys stored in workspaces. Some users reported unauthorized charges, including about 400 USD on an Anthropic account and about 200 EUR on Google. OpenCode is coordinating its response with Anthropic, OpenAI and Google. Anthropic's Lydia Hallie said Claude API keys believed to be affected had been revoked and advised anyone who had stored keys in OpenCode to regenerate them. The incident remains under investigation, and details have not been released.

腾讯混元 10 月 16 日开源 Hy-Memory 2.0，三层都放出：专做长期记忆写入的 Hy-Memory-30B-A3B（约 3B 激活，Apache 2.0），覆盖聊天、工作、代码三类记忆的引擎和 Python SDK hy-memory，以及本地优先的桌面 / CLI 应用 MemHub，可把 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、OpenCode 等工具的对话和编码记录汇成一份个人记忆。官方模型卡显示，把它替换进 Mem0、MemOS、Hy-Memory、EverMemOS 四套框架当记忆写入器，四框架宏平均 55.49，高于 Claude Opus 5 的 54.62 和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 的 53.64（各基准取固定 20% 子样本）。On Oct 16 Tencent Hunyuan open-sourced all three layers of Hy-Memory 2.0: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B, a model dedicated to writing long-term memory (about 3B active, Apache 2.0); the hy-memory engine and Python SDK covering chat, work and code memory; and MemHub, a local-first desktop / CLI app that merges conversations and coding sessions from Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode and others into one personal memory. Claude 破解 NIST 椭圆曲线种子之谜：NSA 当年用 lrand48 加 Unix 时间戳生成，无后门Claude cracks the NIST curve seed mystery: NSA used lrand48 seeded with Unix timestamps, no backdoor

Anthropic 研究博客：ECDSA 标准里 NIST 曲线的「种子」由 NSA 提供、多年没有解释来源。Claude 猜测其来自上世纪 90 年代 C 库的弱随机数生成器，写扫描器发现部分种子最高位全为 0（随机出现概率约 1/5810），锁定 lrand48，再用 LLL 格基约化恢复内部状态，回推出 10 条素数域曲线的初始化值都是 1997 年 5 月到 1998 年 4 月间的 Unix 时间戳。结论是「只是时间戳」，不需要任何应对措施。HN 657 分。Anthropic research: the seeds behind NIST's ECDSA curves came from the NSA with no explanation. Claude guessed a weak 1990s C-library PRNG, found the top bit was zero in some seeds (about 1/5810 odds by chance), pinned it to lrand48, recovered internal states with LLL lattice reduction, and traced all ten prime-curve seeds to Unix timestamps between May 1997 and April 1998. Verdict: "it's just timestamps", nothing to change. 657 points on HN.

The approach was to first make automated review broad and deep enough, then change the goal to using as little human review time as possible without adding reverts or incidents. The post walks through how a change flows, layered review, how to make review agents stronger, where humans must step in, and the rule that whoever merges a change owns it, plus steps for outside teams to adopt it.

商务部、科技部拟将 23 项人工智能技术列入出口管制目录：涉及大模型、智能体、算力集群，开源技术不纳入China's Ministry of Commerce and Ministry of Science and Technology propose adding 23 AI technologies to export controls, covering large models, agents and compute clusters, with open-source tech excluded

商务部、科技部 10 月 16 日发布 2026 年第 48 号公告，就修订《中国禁止出口限制出口技术目录》公开征求意见，拟新增人工智能、生物医药、光伏三个领域 40 项技术，其中禁止出口 14 项、限制出口 26 项。人工智能方面拟增列大模型、智能体、算力集群、信息处理相关 23 项，例如禁止类的「人工智能驱动的恶意代码生成与变异技术」、限制类的「人工智能辅助漏洞挖掘技术」。商务部发言人表示，已通过开源、发表论文进入公共领域的技术不纳入管理；AI 技术开源、企业在境外自建算力中心、赴境外流片等情形适用自动许可，基本「即报即出」，大模型出海是否受管关键看是否涉及限制类技术向境外转移。On Oct 16 the Ministry of Commerce and the Ministry of Science and Technology issued Announcement No. 48 of 2026, seeking public comment on revising the Catalogue of Technologies Prohibited or Restricted from Export. It proposes adding 40 technologies across AI, biomedicine and photovoltaics (14 prohibited, 26 restricted). For AI it proposes 23 items related to large models, agents, compute clusters and information processing, such as "AI-driven malicious code generation and mutation" (prohibited) and "AI-assisted vulnerability discovery" (restricted). A MOFCOM spokesperson said technologies already in the public domain through open source or published papers are not covered; open-sourcing AI tech, companies building their own compute centers abroad and taping out chips abroad fall under automatic licensing, essentially approved on filing, and whether a model going overseas is covered depends on whether restricted technology is transferred abroad.

POLITICO：Anthropic 向国会推介 AI 监管草案，只有可能致损超 10 亿美元或 50 人以上伤亡才可叫停模型POLITICO: Anthropic pitches Congress a bill letting regulators halt models only for $1B+ harm or 50+ casualties

据 POLITICO（IT之家转述），Anthropic 悄悄向国会议员推介前沿 AI 安全法案草案：只有模型可能造成可预见、迫在眉睫的「超 10 亿美元经济损失」或「50 人以上死亡或重伤」，且风险来自生物武器、模型失控或严重网络攻击时，政府才能叫停发布或使用。草案会推翻部分州级 AI 法律，同时要求前沿实验室建立安全框架、发布透明度报告、保护举报人、向商务部通报重大事故。Per POLITICO (via IT之家), Anthropic quietly pitched lawmakers a frontier-AI safety bill: the government could halt a model's release or use only for foreseeable, imminent risk of over $1B in damage or 50+ deaths or serious injuries, arising from bioweapons, loss of control or severe cyberattacks. It would preempt some state AI laws while requiring frontier labs to keep safety frameworks, publish transparency reports, protect whistleblowers and report major incidents to Commerce.

Vendor claims #1 on Vals Index (68.9%), DeepSWE v1.1 at 77.9%, and ERQA embodied reasoning at 87%.

He says code, tests, review, and draft write-ups were done with Claude Code under his guidance. On his laptop, 8-thread 16-byte reads dropped from ~2950 to ~725 kernel cycles. Not in mainline yet; reclaim issues remain.
